audience: sales teams that work leads, follow-up tasks and opportunities in LeadSquared

useCases.title: Find leads by text or by one field
useCases.text: Quick-search leads by name, email, phone or company, or search by one field such as creation date. Then read one lead.

useCases.title: Review tasks and activities of a lead
useCases.text: List the follow-up tasks and the activities of one lead, such as calls, emails and notes.

useCases.title: Check the opportunities and owner of a lead
useCases.text: List the opportunities linked to one lead, and the users of the account to find an owner.

useCases.title: Create or update a lead
useCases.text: Create a lead, or update the lead that has the same email address or phone number.

useCases.title: Post a note on a lead
useCases.text: Add a note or a custom activity to one lead. Each call adds a new activity.
